data.name: RAID VR
data.detailed_description:
R.A.I.D is a VR co-op roguelite FPS set in deep space, where you serve as an ESF customs agent responsible for inspecting interstellar cargo traffic and intercepting smuggling operations.

This is a hybrid VR experience combining simulation-style inspection gameplay with fast-paced first-person shooter combat. Scan incoming space trucks, analyze cargo manifests, and decide which ships are cleared—or escalated for boarding and tactical assault.

When interception is required, you board massive procedurally generated spacecraft filled with pirates, alien threats, and valuable contraband. Fight through room-based ship interiors in intense VR combat, either solo or in up to 4-player online co-op.

Progression is driven by a roguelite structure and the ESF Ranger Rank system. Players earn credits and protocol points across repeated missions (shifts), unlocking new weapons, permanent upgrades, and milestone abilities. Weapon mods introduce explosive effects, overcharged energy shots, and experimental wormhole mechanics that alter combat encounters.

Each mission is a timed run with selectable risk levels that influence difficulty, cargo value, and rewards. Every fourth shift escalates into a large-scale boarding mission with higher enemy density, expanded ship layouts, and increased loot potential.

Built for VR immersion and simulation-style interaction, R.A.I.D uses fully diegetic systems: wrist-based health tracking, weapon-mounted ammo displays, and physical control terminals instead of traditional HUD elements.

Designed for both stationary VR gameplay and optional stick locomotion, the game supports comfortable play without reducing combat intensity.

Features

  • VR co-op roguelite FPS gameplay with replayable mission structure

  • Space simulation-inspired cargo inspection and risk assessment system

  • Fast-paced VR shooter combat with boarding missions

  • Solo and 4-player online co-op multiplayer

  • Procedurally generated spacecraft and dungeon-like ship interiors

  • Roguelite progression system with persistent upgrades and rank progression

  • Weapon customization with experimental sci-fi abilities and mods

  • Physics-driven VR interaction and fully diegetic UI systems

  • Hybrid gameplay: simulation + FPS + roguelite loop

  • Designed for comfortable VR (stationary play + optional locomotion)

data.short_description: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 4-player co-op action.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 5 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
  • VR Support: OpenXR, Meta Quest 2+3+3S, Index, Pimax, Index Knuckles, Pico.
